name: present-your-work
description: Present finished work to the person who asked for it, in the chat, in under a minute: the goal and the answer first, why it was done this way and its key idea, the one limitation that matters beside the answer, every claimed check tied to its evidence, and what the reader now has to decide or do. A one-second standard-library script checks private labels, budgets, superlatives, checks claimed without evidence, unnamed test changes and log-like telling.
